According to the course material, how many categories of common knowledge are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two categories of common knowledge:  information that's known to the general public  information that is agreed upon by most people in a professional field Sometimes common knowledge can be tricky to define but a good rule is if a researcher is in doubt, s/he should document.
